purpose: Science Owner's Stage-4 sensor-value decision-input matrix. NOT the final architecture - architecture_implication values are decision inputs (STRONGLY_SUPPORTED_CORE / SUPPORTED / CONTEXTUAL_LOW_BURDEN / MIXED / DEPRIORITIZED / EXPERIMENTAL / PENDING_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION), never KEEP/REMOVE. final_architecture_status remains UNRESOLVED.

modalities.supported_target_use: heart rate estimation (baseline signal for all wrist HR/IMU comparisons)
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: PPG-DaLiA capacity-controlled and GalaxyPPG corrected full-CV both use PPG as the baseline modality that IMU is added to - PPG itself is the load-bearing signal in every wrist-HR result.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: None - PPG is the baseline, not itself under test as an optional addition.
modalities.external_replication_status: N/A (baseline modality, not an incremental addition under test)
modalities.burden_relevance: Already required for any wrist-HR architecture; adding IMU shares the same wearable module.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: None material to this modality's own inclusion.

modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: PPG-DaLiA capacity-controlled (A_cap->B +0.605 bpm, 5/5 seeds) AND GalaxyPPG corrected full-CV (participant A_cap->B +0.834 bpm, 12/18 favor B; independent device/subject family) - two datasets, consistent direction.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: GalaxyPPG discloses real subject heterogeneity: 6/18 subjects favor A_cap (no-IMU) over B.
modalities.external_replication_status: EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_SUPPORTIVE (GalaxyPPG, independent device/subject family from PPG-DaLiA)
modalities.burden_relevance: Co-locatable with wrist PPG in the same wearable module - near-zero marginal contact-region/module burden.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: None material - this is the strongest-evidence modality in the current package.

modalities.supported_target_use: not directly tested in any Stage-3 governing experiment in this package
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: None in the current governing evidence set.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: None in the current governing evidence set.
modalities.burden_relevance: Could co-locate with wrist PPG/IMU module if adopted - low marginal contact burden, but scientific value not yet established.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: No Stage-3 experiment currently tests this modality.

modalities.supported_target_use: not directly tested in any Stage-3 governing experiment in this package
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: None in the current governing evidence set.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: None in the current governing evidence set.
modalities.burden_relevance: Could co-locate with wrist PPG optical path (shared photodiode/AFE possibility, not scientifically confirmed).
modalities.unresolved_evidence: No Stage-3 experiment currently tests this modality.

modalities.supported_target_use: reference/ground-truth HR signal (GalaxyPPG's Polar H10 reference); also LBNP's condition-A input alongside pleth
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: Used as the real reference-quality ground truth underlying GalaxyPPG's entire eligibility/QC pipeline and as LBNP's condition-A baseline input.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: Not itself under test as an optional incremental addition in the current package.
modalities.external_replication_status: N/A (used as reference/baseline input, not an incremental-value candidate itself)
modalities.burden_relevance: Real, distinct contact-region/module burden from wrist devices (chest strap or patch).
modalities.unresolved_evidence: None material to its role as a reference signal.

modalities.supported_target_use: LBNP-induced central hypovolemic stress stage estimation, beyond ECG+pleth
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: None - B (A+EIS) is worse than A on average, and worse than its own deranged control C.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: LBNP protocol-compliant v2: A_minus_B=-0.452 (sign-reverses without subject 9), C_minus_B=-1.293 (shrinks substantially without subject 9) - COMPLETE_MIXED, negative-leaning.
modalities.heterogeneity: HIGH - both key comparisons substantially subject-9-influenced.
modalities.incremental_value_status: COMPLETE_MIXED (negative-leaning, heterogeneous, not a uniform negative)
modalities.burden_relevance: Requires a dedicated EIS acquisition module distinct from existing PPG/ECG modules - real added burden with, per current evidence, unclear benefit for this specific target.
modalities.confidence_tier: MEDIUM (real n=12 experiment, but high subject-sensitivity)
modalities.unresolved_evidence: Abdominal/arm EIS sites and other targets remain untested; only the LBNP-stage target and thoracic site were tested.

modalities.supported_target_use: 5-class sleep-stage classification (baseline signal underlying all Sleep-EDF/HMC comparisons)
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: Foundation signal for the sleep-staging task across Sleep-EDF (corrected A/B/C, interaction) and HMC bounded diagnostic.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: None - EEG is the baseline, not itself under test as an optional addition.
modalities.burden_relevance: Already required for any sleep-staging architecture; EOG can potentially share AFE/reference infrastructure.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: None material to this modality's own inclusion.

modalities.supported_target_use: incremental sleep-stage classification value beyond EEG-only
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: Sleep-EDF corrected A/B (B_minus_A=+0.0282, 4/5 seeds) AND corrected shuffled control C (B_minus_C=+0.0323, 4/5 seeds favor B over control) - a genuine, control-verified same-dataset effect.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: HMC bounded n=7 diagnostic shows B_minus_A=-0.0313 (2/5 seeds favor B) - did NOT reproduce at this bounded scale, though n=7/1-test-recording is far too small to conclude non-replication.
modalities.external_replication_status: PENDING_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION (HMC full-151-cohort training LOWER_PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_WORK_PENDING; the bounded n=7 diagnostic is inconclusive, not a negative external replication)
modalities.heterogeneity: Same-dataset result is fairly consistent (4/5 seeds both comparisons); the bounded external diagnostic disagrees but is statistically underpowered to be informative either way.
modalities.burden_relevance: Can plausibly share EEG's amplifier/reference/electrode infrastructure - marginal hardware burden may be lower than treating it as a fully independent module (a scientific/engineering interface point, not yet engineering-confirmed).
modalities.confidence_tier: MEDIUM (strong same-dataset signal, external validity genuinely open)
modalities.unresolved_evidence: HMC full-cohort training could materially change confidence in EOG's independent value - HIGH decision sensitivity to this pending result.

modalities.supported_target_use: baseline-relative body-mass-change proxy, incremental beyond arms+trunk BioZ
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: 7/10 individual subjects favor B (arms+trunk+legs) over A (arms+trunk only) in raw direction.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: Aggregate mean disfavors B (A_minus_B=-0.052) and disfavors B relative to its own deranged control C (C_minus_B=-0.060) - single-outlier-dominated ambiguity disclosed in the governing artifact.
modalities.burden_relevance: Requires bilateral leg electrode placement - a real added contact-region burden beyond arms+trunk BioZ, with unclear benefit per current evidence.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: Whether a larger cohort or outlier-robust design would resolve the aggregate/per-subject tension is not established either way.

modalities.supported_target_use: pulse-transit-time-based estimation, incremental beyond a single PPG site
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: None - B (second site added) is worse than A on aggregate mean.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: B_minus_A=+1.462 MAE (worse), fragile per-seed deltas (0.07 to 2.11), and prior sprints established the aggregate can flip sign under single-subject exclusion at n=4 test subjects.
modalities.burden_relevance: Requires an additional PPG measurement site/module - real added burden with, per current evidence, no demonstrated benefit.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: Whether a larger held-out test set would stabilize the direction is not established.

modalities.anatomical_site: N/A (derived signal in the Sleep-EDF interaction experiment)
modalities.supported_target_use: sleep-stage classification, tested only in combination with EOG (interaction experiment)
modalities.strongest_positive_evidence: MB (EEG+Resp) > M0 (EEG-only): +0.0061 - a small positive marginal contribution on its own.
modalities.strongest_negative_evidence: No stable synergy or antagonism with EOG (interaction_mean=-0.0078, mixed-sign seeds) - combining EOG+Resp is not scientifically justified as a joint decision beyond each one's own individual contribution.
modalities.heterogeneity: Interaction term noisy relative to its own magnitude at n=5 seeds.
modalities.incremental_value_status: MIXED_UNRESOLVED (as a joint addition with EOG)
modalities.burden_relevance: Derived signal in this experiment (not a standalone sensor evaluated for burden here) - not independently assessed for hardware burden.
modalities.unresolved_evidence: Whether respiration has stand-alone incremental value independent of EOG was not the tested question.
